summary: A wizard label is only translatable if a translator can reach it. 37 of 38 wizard label_tokens are wizards.* slugs with NO catalog entry anywhere, so they render title-cased English on all 21 locales forever. The rule this replaced asserted the opposite: it required label_token to START WITH 'wizards.', which flagged the single wizard (mfa_setup) whose label IS a real msgid and passed the 37 that are structurally untranslatable.
ratchet: This list may only SHRINK. An unreachable label not listed here fails the gate; a listed label that becomes reachable fails the gate until it is deleted from this file; an entry with no reason fails the gate.

unreachable.reason: 'wizards.academic_year_setup.label' is not a msgid in any of the 21 shipped catalogs, so gettext() returns it unchanged and humanize_wizard_token falls through to title-casing the slug: every locale renders 'Academic Year Setup'. There is nothing for a translator to translate. Fixing it is an i18n architecture decision -- emit wizards.* tokens into the catalog from sync_i18n_catalog, or carry real English msgids as mfa_setup does -- and belongs to the operator, not to this gate.
